summary: On RHEL, copy the monthly report with `scp -r user@controller_host:$METRICS_UTILITY_SHIP_PATH/data/<YYYY>/<MM>/ /local/dir/`; the report is saved as CCSP-<YEAR>-<MONTH>.xlsx in the ship path.
questions: How do I download the metrics-utility report on RHEL?
What is the CCSP xlsx report file name?
Where does metrics-utility save the monthly report?
